name: Shaolong
description: (Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:water)Known as the Water God: a serpentine dragon of white and blue scales, golden horns, and a mane of living water. It commands every river, sea, and storm it crosses, parting floods, raising standing waves to swallow armies, and calling typhoons down on a coast. It needs no saddle to be ridden and never tires in water or in flight.
